title: MasterConfigSchema
description: Google Antigravity global system configuration schema (~/.gemini/config/config.json).

browserJsExecutionPolicy.description: Execution policy for JavaScript in browser subagent actions.

enableTerminalSandbox.description: Whether to enforce terminal OS sandboxing.

allow.description: List of global allow rules (e.g. unsandboxed(bin), command(git status), read_url(domain)).

deny.description: List of global deny rules (e.g. mcp(server/tool), read_file(path)).

globalPermissionGrants.description: Global allow and deny authorization rules across tools and commands.

nonWorkspaceFileAccessPolicy.description: Access policy for reading/modifying files outside workspace roots.

queuedMessageDeliveryStrategy.description: Delivery cadence for background and user-queued messages.

remoteControlHostname.description: Hostname for remote control agent bridge.

plugins.description: Map of installed ecosystem plugin names to their enabled status or plugin configuration.
